m1_zero_omission_notes.chapter_executive_summary: Derives formulas for perimeter (circumference) and area of a circle, arc length of a sector (θ/360 * 2πr), area of sector (θ/360 * πr^2), and area of segment (Sector area - Triangle area).

detailed_section_hierarchy.section_number_title: 11.1 Area of Sector & Segment of a Circle
detailed_section_hierarchy.full_explanation: Sector: region enclosed by two radii and arc. Segment: region bounded by chord and arc. Sector Area = (θ/360) * πr^2. Arc Length = (θ/360) * 2πr.

glossary_and_key_terms.definition: Region enclosed by two radii and the corresponding arc.
Region enclosed by a chord and the corresponding arc.

formulas_rules_and_laws.name: Sector and Arc Formulas
formulas_rules_and_laws.statement_or_expression: Area of Sector = (θ/360) * πr^2; Arc Length l = (θ/360) * 2πr; Area of Segment = Area of Sector - Area of Δ
formulas_rules_and_laws.variable_definitions: r = radius, θ = central angle in degrees

questions_and_answers.answer: The full area of the circle, πr^2.

m7_common_pitfalls_and_misconceptions.frequent_student_error: Using circumference formula 2πr when area πr^2 is required in sector calculation.
m7_common_pitfalls_and_misconceptions.root_cause: Formula confusion between linear boundary and 2D surface.
m7_common_pitfalls_and_misconceptions.correct_approach: Arc length uses 2πr; Sector area uses πr^2.
